Auto Body & Paint · Palmyra, NY

Body and paint that blends in.

Bumper scuffs, creased panels, scratches and chips, repaired and refinished to match.

Request a Free EstimateCall (315) 584-1944

Body repair

Damaged panels and bumpers are repaired or replaced, cracked bumper covers are repaired when that’s the right call, and panel gaps are restored so doors, hoods and trunks close properly.

Paint and refinishing

Factory colors vary from car to car. A good match starts with the paint code, is adjusted to your vehicle’s actual color, and is blended into neighboring panels so it disappears in sunlight.

  • Scratch and chip repair
  • Bumper repair and refinishing
  • Panel refinishing and blending

Backed for as long as you own it

Our workmanship is warranted for as long as you own the vehicle. Parts carry the manufacturer’s warranty. If something isn’t right with our repair, bring it back and we’ll make it right.

Common questions

Will the new paint match?

That’s the goal of every refinish: matched to your car as it is today and blended so the repair can’t be picked out.

Can a cracked bumper be repaired?

It depends on where it’s damaged and whether the mounting tabs and sensors are intact. We’ll tell you which option is right and why.

How much will my repair cost?

Cost depends on the extent of the damage, the parts and materials needed, and the labor required. Your estimate is free, and we always provide transparent pricing information.
